# RH850 against `v850-elf-as -mv850e3v5`. One statement per line; `#` lines
# are comments. Cases that assemble the same as on V850 live in v850.txt; this
# file has what RH850 adds or encodes differently.

# ---- the base set, spot-checked under -mv850e3v5
mov r1, r2
add -16, r2
movhi hi(0x12348000), r0, r2
ld.w 8[r1], r2
jarl 2, lp
ldsr r1, psw
stsr psw, r1
bz -2

# ---- 48-bit mov, chosen when the value misses the 5-bit form
mov 16, r10
mov -17, r10
mov 0x12345678, r10
mov -0x80000000, r1
mov 0xffffffff, r1
mov 5, r0
mov hilo(0x12345678), r1
mov hilo(5), r1

# ---- three-operand shifts and rotates, saturating arithmetic
shl r1, r2, r3
shr r1, r2, r3
sar r1, r2, r3
rotl r1, r2, r3
rotl 5, r2, r3
rotl 31, r31, r1
satadd r1, r2, r3
satsub r1, r2, r3
adf z, r1, r2, r3
sbf nz, r1, r2, r3

# ---- multiply and divide
mul r1, r2, r3
mul 5, r2, r3
mul -256, r2, r3
mul 255, r2, r3
mulu r1, r2, r3
mulu 511, r2, r3
div r1, r2, r3
divu r1, r2, r3
divh r1, r2, r3
divhu r1, r2, r3
divq r1, r2, r3
divqu r1, r2, r3
mac r1, r2, r4, r6
macu r1, r2, r4, r6

# ---- byte swaps and bit searches
bsh r1, r2
bsw r1, r2
hsh r1, r2
hsw r1, r2
sch0l r1, r2
sch0r r1, r2
sch1l r1, r2
sch1r r1, r2
bsw r31, r0

# ---- bins: the three encodings for a field above, across and below bit 16
bins r1, 0, 8, r2
bins r1, 8, 16, r2
bins r1, 20, 4, r2
bins r1, 0, 32, r2
bins r1, 15, 2, r2
bins r1, 31, 1, r2
bins r1, 16, 16, r2
bins r1, 15, 1, r2
bins r1, 0, 16, r2
bins r1, 16, 1, r2
bins r1, 0, 1, r2
bins r1, 20, 12, r2

# ---- sign and zero extension, conditional move and set
sxb r1
sxh r1
zxb r1
zxh r1
cmov z, r1, r2, r3
cmov nz, 5, r2, r3
cmov sa, r1, r2, r3
sasf c, r1
sasf sa, r1

# ---- short loads without sign extension
sld.bu 5[ep], r2
sld.bu 15[ep], r2
sld.bu -1[ep], r2
sld.hu 6[ep], r2
sld.hu 30[ep], r2
ld.bu 5[r1], r2
ld.bu -1[r1], r2
ld.bu 0x7fff[r1], r2
ld.hu 6[r1], r2
ld.bu lo(0x12348001)[r1], r2

# ---- 48-bit loads and stores, chosen when the displacement misses 16 bits
ld.b 0x8000[r1], r2
ld.b 0x3fffff[r1], r2
ld.bu 0x8000[r1], r2
ld.bu -32769[r1], r2
ld.bu -0x8001[r1], r2
ld.hu 0x8000[r1], r2
ld.h 0x8000[r1], r2
ld.w 0x10000[r1], r2
ld.w -0x400000[r1], r2
ld.w 0x3ffffe[r1], r2
st.w r2, 0x10000[r1]
st.h r2, -0x8002[r1]
ld.dw 8[r1], r2
st.dw r2, 8[r1]
st.dw r2, 0x10000[r1]
ldl.w [r1], r2
stc.w r2, [r1]

# ---- jumps: through a register, and the 48-bit forms for far constants
jarl [r1], r2
jarl r1, lp
jarl 0x200000, r1
jr 0x200000
jr -0x200002
jmp 0x12345678[r1]
jmp -2[r1]
jmp 0x80000000[r1]
switch r1
callt 0
callt 63
ctret

# ---- bit operations with the bit number in a register
set1 r1, [r2]
clr1 r1, [r2]
tst1 r1, [r2]
not1 r1, [r2]

# ---- system registers with a group, and the RH850 names
ldsr r1, psw, 1
ldsr r1, sr31, 31
ldsr r1, ctbp
ldsr r1, 31
ldsr r1, 32
ldsr r1, 1023
stsr psw, r1, 1
stsr 5, r1
stsr ctpc, r1
stsr fpsr, r1
stsr 1023, r1
ldtc.gr r1, r2
ldtc.sr r1, 5
ldtc.vr r1, vr5
ldtc.pc r1
ldvc.sr r1, 5
sttc.gr r1, r2
sttc.sr 5, r1
sttc.vr vr5, r1
sttc.pc r1
stvc.sr 5, r1

# ---- prepare and dispose
prepare {r20-r29, r31}, 4
prepare {r31}, 0
prepare {}, 0
prepare {r20}, 31
prepare {r30}, 0
prepare {ep, lp}, 1
prepare {r29, r28, r20}, 2
prepare {r20 - r22}, 0
prepare {r20,r21,r22,r23,r24,r25,r26,r27,r28,r29,r30,r31}, 0
prepare 0xfff, 0
prepare {r20-r29, r31}, 4, sp
prepare {r20-r29, r31}, 4, 0x10
prepare {r20-r29, r31}, 4, -1
prepare {r20-r29, r31}, 4, 0x8000
prepare {r20-r29, r31}, 4, 0x10000
prepare {r20-r29, r31}, 4, 0x12345678
prepare {}, 0, 0
prepare {}, 0, 0xffffffff
prepare {}, 0, 0xffff8000
prepare {}, 0, -0x8001
prepare {}, 0, 0x7fff
prepare {}, 0, 0xffff
prepare {}, 0, hi(0x12348000)
prepare {}, 0, lo(0x12348000)
prepare {}, 0, hilo(0x12348000)
dispose 4, {r20-r29, r31}
dispose 4, {r20-r29, r31}, r31
dispose 0, {r31}, [lp]
dispose 0, {}
dispose 31, {r30}
dispose 0, {}, [r31]
dispose 0, {}, r1

# ---- stack and debug
pushsp r20-r25
pushsp r20, r25
pushsp r20-r20
pushsp r25-r20
pushsp r0-r31
popsp r20-r25
popsp r1, r1
dbpush r1-r3
dbtag 5
dbtag 1023
dbtrap
dbret
dbcp
dbhvtrap

# ---- exceptions, traps and control
eiret
feret
fetrap 1
fetrap 15
syscall 0
syscall 255
hvcall 5
hvcall 255
hvtrap 5
hvtrap 31
rie
rie 1, 2
rie 31, 15
rmtrap
synce
synci
syncm
syncp
snooze
tlbai
tlbr
tlbs
tlbvi
tlbw
dst
est
caxi [r1], r2, r3
caxi r1, r2, r3
cache chbii, [r1]
cache cistd, [r1]
cache 0x7f, [r1]
pref prefi, [r1]
pref prefd, [r1]
pref 4, [r1]

# ---- loop with a numeric backward distance
loop r1, 10
loop r1, 0xfffe

# ---- floating point
absf.d r2, r4
absf.s r1, r2
addf.d r2, r4, r6
addf.s r1, r2, r3
ceilf.dl r2, r4
ceilf.dul r2, r4
ceilf.duw r2, r3
ceilf.dw r2, r3
ceilf.sl r1, r4
ceilf.sul r1, r4
ceilf.suw r1, r3
ceilf.sw r1, r3
cmovf.d 1, r2, r4, r6
cmovf.d r2, r4, r6
cmovf.s 7, r1, r2, r3
cmovf.s r1, r2, r3
cmpf.d eq, r2, r4
cmpf.d eq, r2, r4, 3
cmpf.s lt, r1, r2
cmpf.s ule, r1, r2, 7
cmpf.s 5, r1, r2
cvtf.dl r2, r4
cvtf.ds r2, r3
cvtf.dul r2, r4
cvtf.duw r2, r3
cvtf.dw r2, r3
cvtf.hs r1, r2
cvtf.ld r2, r4
cvtf.ls r2, r3
cvtf.sd r1, r4
cvtf.sl r1, r4
cvtf.sh r1, r2
cvtf.sul r1, r4
cvtf.suw r1, r3
cvtf.sw r1, r3
cvtf.uld r2, r4
cvtf.uls r2, r3
cvtf.uwd r1, r4
cvtf.uws r1, r3
cvtf.wd r1, r4
cvtf.ws r1, r3
divf.d r2, r4, r6
divf.s r1, r2, r3
floorf.dl r2, r4
floorf.dul r2, r4
floorf.duw r2, r3
floorf.dw r2, r3
floorf.sl r1, r4
floorf.sul r1, r4
floorf.suw r1, r3
floorf.sw r1, r3
fmaf.s r1, r2, r3
fmsf.s r1, r2, r3
fnmaf.s r1, r2, r3
fnmsf.s r1, r2, r3
maxf.d r2, r4, r6
maxf.s r1, r2, r3
minf.d r2, r4, r6
minf.s r1, r2, r3
mulf.d r2, r4, r6
mulf.s r1, r2, r3
negf.d r2, r4
negf.s r1, r2
recipf.d r2, r4
recipf.s r1, r2
rsqrtf.d r2, r4
rsqrtf.s r1, r2
sqrtf.d r2, r4
sqrtf.s r1, r2
subf.d r2, r4, r6
subf.s r1, r2, r3
trfsr
trfsr 3
trfsr 7
trncf.dl r2, r4
trncf.dul r2, r4
trncf.duw r2, r3
trncf.dw r2, r3
trncf.sl r1, r4
trncf.sul r1, r4
trncf.suw r1, r3
